overall_goal: Remove the fish cakes from the oven, prepare for serving, and tidy up the kitchen counter

goals.description: Remove the baking tray from the oven and take the fish cakes off the tray
goals.rationale: The person puts on an oven mitt, opens the oven, pulls out the baking tray, and uses a spatula to remove the fish cakes.

goals.description: Prepare the plate and cutlery for serving
goals.rationale: The person reconsiders using the oven mitt, pulls a plate forward, and opens a drawer to grab cutlery.

goals.description: Tidy up the baking tray and tea towel
goals.rationale: The person moves the baking tray and oven mitt out of the way, then folds and hangs the tea towel on the oven door.
